findings: Guide page6 separates gross tax, minimum-tax-limited relief, other credits, penalties, prior payments and relief recapture; a single final-tax multiplier is insufficient.
Corporate Tax Act64 lists relief/credits, interim tax, occasional assessments and withholding (penalties excluded from the listed offsets); installment rules are separate.
National Treasury Act47 distinguishes fractional-won tax base from sub-KRW10 receipts/disbursements; decree exceptions still require review.
Local Accounting Act55 permits sub-KRW10 treatment rather than establishing a universal mandatory local-tax rule.
